versions.text: Where sacrificial elements of the structure are used to deploy the parachute or to activate the shock absorber system, (a) the number of such elements must be minimised (b) the structural integrity of the UAV airframe must not be reduced after the release or operation of these sacrificial elements.

Where sacrificial elements of the structure are used to deploy the parachute or to activate the shock absorber system:
(a) the number of such elements must be minimised.
(b) the structural integrity of the UA airframe must not be reduced after the release or operation of these sacrificial elements.
